title: FB5 -- Add custom order: Move up/down, dragging, auto-switch to Custom
description: Brief: read docs/agent-work/2026-11-18-folders-batch/PLAN.md sections 'Rules in force', 'Common commands', 'Notes for the implementer', then task FB5 only; its Interfaces names are contracts. Model: Opus. What: Any hand reorder switches the sort to Custom; Move up/down, Option+arrows and pointer dragging for projects and folders, drop onto a folder heading files a project; reordering is off during search. Verify: libraryDrag unit test and tests/fb-folder-order.spec.ts pass. Write notes to docs/agent-work/2026-11-18-folders-batch/notes/FB5.md with fail-first and passing output. Shared files (styles.css, App.tsx, ProjectSidebar.tsx, layoutBudget.json) are edited by small region with the Edit tool and are not registered. Do not commit.

handoff.text: REVIEW-3 (docs/agent-work/2026-11-18-folders-batch/reviews/REVIEW-3.md). Custom order itself is sound: tsc clean; vitest 46 passed; the 6 Projects specs 84 passed 2 skipped; layout-invariants Projects|T5 7 passed. One medium: choosing "Move to folder..." on a row/card partly hidden by main.library (1280x560, cards, real mouse by coordinates) closes the destination menu on the first try -- ContextMenu.choose calls onClose(true) before run(); ProjectLibrary closeMenu (line 165) restores focus with a plain .focus(), which scrolls the row into view (scrollTop 0->5) and the new menu closes on that scroll. A second try works. Patching focus to preventScroll fixes it (probe). The fb-folders 1280x900 viewport hides this. Fixes: (1) ProjectLibrary.tsx closeMenu: tree.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(selector)?.focus({ preventScroll: true }) (or skip the restore when the chosen item reopens the Move to folder menu). (2) tests/fb-folders.spec.ts: put the default viewport back on "Move to folder files a project..." and add a regression that at 1280x560 in card view right-clicks a card partly below the fold by mouse coordinates, clicks "Move to folder..." by coordinates, and expects the destination rows visible; show it failing on the current tree first. Lows (drop-into appends last, no drag to empty top level, a move under another sort replaces that container hand order, narrow-window card widths) are owner decisions, not required.

review.note: Coordinator re-review of the REVIEW-3 repair: closeMenu restores focus with preventScroll; the 1280x900 override is gone and a 1280x560 short-window regression test was shown failing first; heading drops now file first like Move to folder. tsc clean, 24 unit and 68 browser tests passed after the repair. The Opus review (REVIEW-3.md) found nothing else above low.
